# The validation logic:
# - Input must be 22 chars
# - Must start with "KEY{" and end with "}"
# - For each byte i from 0 to 21:
#   (input[i] ^ edx) == expected[i]
#   then edx = edx + input[i]
# - edx starts at 0x11 (17)

# Expected bytes at 0x402060
expected = bytes([0x5a, 0x19, 0xf8, 0x81, 0x04, 0x93, 0x6a, 0xbf, 
                  0xcb, 0x6c, 0xf6, 0x84, 0x58, 0xe8, 0x57, 0x09,
                  0xba, 0x1b, 0xd0, 0x7f, 0x18, 0x9b])

# To reverse: input[i] = expected[i] ^ edx
# Then update edx = edx + input[i]

edx = 0x11  # starts at 17
result = []

for i in range(22):
    char = expected[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)  # XOR with lower byte
    result.append(char)
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xffffffff  # update edx, keeping it as 32-bit

solution = bytes(result)
print("Solution:", solution)
print("As string:", solution.decode('latin-1'))
print("Starts with KEY{?:", solution[:4])
print("Ends with }?:", chr(solution[-1]))
